500-2187-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-2187-4923.description:

Repeat each turn.

Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Aeromoeba by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling the nontoken Felidar Guardian until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
